name: Astro OG social card by astro.build
description: A 1200×630 dark card split roughly 55/45: the left column carries the identity and message (small wordmark with logo mark, a two-line headline that switches from regular to heavy italic mid-sentence, and a rounded mascot icon with a gradient border), while the right half is a purely atmospheric field of blurred, glowing pills in purple, blue, teal, yellow, pink, orange and white, stacked like abstract code lines and bleeding off the canvas edge. A faint square grid texture and a violet ambient glow anchored in the lower left keep the dark background from reading flat. The single type move — regular-to-italic-bold emphasis — gives the card its personality without needing any extra decoration.
